lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Semi-regular grid arrangement of high-luminance circular clusters observed posterior to the gill slits, transitioning from dense groupings near the head to more linear horizontal rows along the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect horizontal rows of blobs, creating a coordinate-like matrix where spots are positioned at the nodes of the intersecting axes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank; the primary ridge displays a sharp luminance transition with high-intensity pixels on the dorsal edge and deep shadows on the ventral edge, extending from the branchial region to the caudal peduncle.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of high-luminance blobs within the dorsal fin silhouette, primarily concentrated along the posterior margin and upper apex.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small irregular notch visible on the posterior trailing edge of the first dorsal fin; no major traumatic scarring or parasitic lesions identified.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly concentrated cluster of miniature high-luminance spots on the leading edge and distal tip of the left pectoral fin.
